claim_boundary: V19AG can establish only whether this frozen archival triplet admits a defensible global detector calibration.
It does not establish astrometric registration, source detection, deblending, color calibration, cluster membership, stellar mass, baryonic current, lensing performance or gravity performance.
The compressed active mosaic removes non-science pre/overscan columns. Its inherited WCS is approximate and may not be used for astrometric claims before a separately frozen catalog solution.
A calibration failure is not a failure of Sigma Gravity; a pass only authorizes a separately frozen deblending protocol.

detector_model.bias_policy: Prescan-only correction is primary. Bias frames test whether any residual two-dimensional bias structure is too large; no two-dimensional master bias is subtracted, consistent with the FORS cookbook warning that it may add noise when structure is small.
detector_model.correction: For each output and detector row, subtract the median of that output's 16-column prescan from its 1008 valid columns. Ignore the overscan, as specified by the ESO FORS pipeline manual. Concatenate only valid port regions into a 2016-by-2048 active mosaic; no read-direction flip is applied because the FIERA header positions the outputs in detector coordinates.
detector_model.flat_policy: Prescan-correct every twilight flat, divide the whole valid mosaic by one global median, median-combine by filter, then renormalize the master flat to global median one. Do not normalize ports separately, so the master flat can correct relative port gain.
detector_model.science_policy: Prescan-correct and divide by the matching normalized master flat. Pixels outside the frozen valid flat range become NaN.
